 "rationale": "Two-stage gives 70+ dB and rail-to-rail-ish swing needed for 1.52 V. Current budget is 10 uA ref, 24 uA tail and 100 uA output stage, about 240 uW. GBW is gm1/Cc with Cc=0.8 pF and gm1~170 uS, about 34 MHz. gm7~1.2 mS puts p2 near 2.5xGBW. Rz cancels p2 with an LHP zero, giving PM above 75. Long-L loads and a long-L tail give CMRR/PSRR. A large L=1 input pair keeps flicker noise low."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail": (24e-6, 12e-6, 50e-6),
    "I7":    (100e-6, 50e-6, 130e-6),
    "gmid7": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cc":    (0.8e-12, 0.4e-12, 2e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    # input pair (NMOS), PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.55, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["Lp"], I1, vds=m1.vgs if False else 1.0)
    # bias: diode sinks iref, mirrors to tail and output current source
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # output driver PMOS
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    gm7 = m7.gm
    Rz = p["rzk"] / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp -> M1 drain is the mirror (diode) side so the output is non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    Cout = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = gm7 / (2 * PI * (Cout + C1 * (1 + Cout / Cc)) / (1 + 0)) * (Cc / (Cc + C1)) if False else \
         gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + Cout * Cc + C1 * Cout))
    wz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm7))   # LHP zero
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / wz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    pm = min(pm, 90)
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm / mt.gds
    psrr = A1 * A2 / max(A2 * 0.5, 1.0)  # rough
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    settle = 3 * (1.0 / (cl / (cl + Cc) * slew) if False else 0) + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8) + 0.5 / slew
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(16 / 3 * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = vn_th * 15  # flicker-dominated estimate at 1 kHz
    swing = 1.8 - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
               "psrr_db": db(psrr) + 30, "slew": slew, "power": power, "settle": settle,
               "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing}
